# alarmwake.com

> Free online alarm clock, timer, stopwatch, Pomodoro timer, interval timer, chess clock, sleep calculator, holiday countdowns and time-zone converter. Everything runs in the browser: no account, no upload, works offline once loaded.

## What it does
- Online alarm clock (/): multiple alarms, 12 synthesized sounds or your own MP3, escalating volume, weekday repeat, snooze, night/OLED bedside mode, sunrise-light screen ramp before the alarm, sleep sounds (rain, brown noise, fan, ocean) until the alarm, a "ready to ring" check, and solve-sums-to-stop for heavy sleepers.
- Set alarm for a specific time: /set-alarm-for-6-30-am/ and every 5 minutes of the day, each with sleep-cycle bedtimes and local sunrise.
- Wake me up in N minutes or hours: /wake-me-up-in-20-minutes/, /wake-me-up-in-8-hours/, every 5 minutes up to 12 hours.
- How long until a time or weekday: /how-long-until-5-00-pm/, /how-long-until-midnight/, /how-many-days-until-monday/ (live countdown + one-tap alarm).
- Timer (/timer/), per-length pages (/timer/10-minutes/), Pomodoro (/pomodoro-timer/), interval/Tabata (/interval-timer/), stopwatch (/stopwatch/), chess clock (/chess-clock/), study/classroom/exam/nap/egg/tea/kitchen/meditation/workout timers.
- Visual timer for kids and ADHD (/visual-timer/), meeting planner (/meeting-planner/), hours calculator (/hours-calculator/), week number (/week-number/), current time by country and US state (/time/in/japan/, /time/in/texas/).
- Set alarm pages exist for every minute of the day (/set-alarm-for-6-31-am/).
- Multi-timer (/multi-timer/), seconds timers (/timer/30-seconds/), military time converter and chart (/military-time/, /military-time/0600/).
- Sleep calculator (/sleep-calculator/): bedtimes and wake times in 90-minute cycles.
- Countdown to any date (/countdown/) and holiday countdowns (/countdown/christmas/, /countdown/new-year/, ...).
- Time zone converter (/time/) with pair pages such as /time/est-to-pst/ including a 24-hour table.

## Limits (honest)
Rings while the tab is open (background tabs on desktop and Android work); iOS Safari needs the page in the foreground; nothing can ring after the browser is closed.

## Privacy
Alarms and settings stay in the browser's local storage. Location for sunrise is used on-device only.
